mapper.select: SELECT shop_id, shop_group_id, name FROM shop WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY shop_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop (user_id, shop_group_id, name) VALUES (#{userId}, #{shopGroupId}, #{name})
mapper.update: UPDATE shop SET name = #{name} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shop WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
